description: This PHP class 'EmailsControllerActionGetFromFields' handles email address retrieval and signature management for the SuiteCRM email module, including functions for getting 'from' fields, outbound email accounts, and user signatures.

classes.name: EmailsControllerActionGetFromFields
classes.description: A class managing email address retrieval, signature handling, and outbound account processing within the SuiteCRM email module.

methods.name: handleActionGetFromFields
methods.description: Handles retrieval of 'from' email fields, collecting data addresses, signatures, and encoding results.

methods.name: getOutboundFromFields
methods.description: Retrieves outbound email addresses for 'from' fields, including system addresses, with JSON encoding.

methods.name: getEmailSignatures
methods.description: Decodes and retrieves email signatures from user preferences.

methods.name: getDefaultSignatures
methods.description: Provides default email signature templates if user signatures are not set.

methods.name: addOutboundEmailAccounts
methods.description: Adds user's outbound email accounts to the data addresses list, including signatures and account attributes.
